prompts.upper_arm_L:
Use case: precise-object-edit / isolated rig layer reconstruction.
References: image 1 is ORIGINAL Wisp, authoritative for skin color, contour weight, chibi proportions and restrained 2D anime shading. Image 2 is the ACCEPTED raised bent left-arm pose, for the anatomical part only. Its smoky halo/background must NOT be copied.
OUTPUT EXACTLY ONE ISOLATED UPPER ARM SKIN LAYER, the character's left arm (viewer-right bracelet side), from shoulder to elbow ONLY. Not a complete arm. No forearm, no hand, no fingers, no bracelets, no shirt/sleeve, no torso, no face, no labels, no other assets.
Orient the segment vertically: shoulder end at the top, elbow end at the bottom, arm straight and relaxed. Show a slender simple chibi upper arm consistent with the references, not muscular, not a realistic anatomical study. Reconstruct the skin normally hidden under the loose sleeve. Slight natural taper toward elbow.
Asset design in SOURCE PIXELS: intended native canvas 80 wide x 204 high. Arm silhouette roughly 62-66 px wide, about 192 px long including the hidden overlap ends. Shoulder and elbow joint centers are approximately at y=20 and y=184 (164px apart), x=40. Both ends need about 18px of smooth skin continuation beyond joint centers for overlap. If a larger output raster is necessary, use these proportions and design it to be uniformly reduced to 80x204; do not reinterpret as a large detailed limb.
Very light peach skin and subtle warm shading exactly like source, thin muted warm-brown outline only on the exposed long side contours. At the two hidden overlap caps, DO NOT draw a dark transverse line or an outlined ellipse: plain uninterrupted skin with a softly rounded opaque end. No elbow crease through the cap, no cut flesh, no dark stump. This is a clean 2D puppet sprite.
Real transparent background, alpha=0 outside the silhouette, opaque inside the skin, only narrow antialiasing at edges. No cast shadow, NO GLOW, no bloom, no vignette, no checkerboard, no diffuse halo. Keep padding around all sides and do not clip either end. One segment only.
prompts.forearm_L:
Create one isolated 2D animation sprite: the FOREARM segment of Wisp's raised left arm, from elbow to wrist, as seen at the viewer-right side of reference image 2. Reference image 1 is the original fully clothed Wisp character and determines the simple chibi drawing style and colors. Reference image 2 determines the accepted arm proportions. Ignore the background glow in image 2.
This single layer is only the forearm. Exclude hand, fingers, upper arm, bracelets, sleeve and all other character parts. Orient the forearm straight vertically, elbow at top and wrist at bottom. Keep it a flat stylized animation part, modest natural taper from elbow toward wrist, same light peach color and subtle warm outline as the references. No anatomy detail or muscular definition.
Intended native canvas: 64x174 pixels. Design about 50px wide at elbow and 40px at wrist, joint centers around x32/y20 and x32/y150, with approximately 18px of plain overlap material beyond both centers. If returned larger, preserve these proportions for uniform downsampling. No dark line across the hidden ends; only outline the long sides. Both hidden ends should be smooth and rounded, fully inside the canvas.
Transparent PNG with true alpha outside the segment, opaque colors inside. No background, no glow, no halo, no cast shadow, no checkerboard or text. One forearm sprite only, no pair or contact sheet.
prompts.hand_L:
Create exactly one transparent PNG sprite of the OPEN LEFT HAND of the fully clothed Wisp character in the reference images. Image 1 is the original character for design and colors. Image 2 shows the approved raised-arm pose, and the hand at its upper right is the hand to reproduce as one isolated rig layer.
Only one hand with a short wrist extension. No bracelets, no arm above the wrist, no sleeve, no second hand, no background, no labels.
Match the accepted pose: palm facing viewer, fingers pointing upward, thumb extending to viewer-left, five fingers total. Match the simple friendly chibi/anime hand, slender small fingers, original pale peach palette, subtle warm contour and restrained flat shading. Preserve the approved pose and hand proportions. No realistic skin texture, no dramatic lighting.
Intended native size 102 x 144 pixels; the visible hand about 88px wide and 118px tall, with an additional 14px plain wrist extension at the bottom for overlap behind the bracelet. If the output is larger, retain this source-pixel design, aspect and proportions so it can be uniformly reduced without distortion.
The wrist extension has no transverse outline at its hidden end. Leave a transparent margin around all sides. Genuine transparency outside the hand, opaque inside, narrow antialiasing. No glow, no vignette, no shadows outside the silhouette, no checkerboard. Ignore and exclude the halo from image 2. Exactly one complete hand sprite.
